symptom: Rotating the control plane's GitHub refresh-binding secret, or the OAuth client secret it fell back to, made every connected desktop show This GitHub connection needs to be re-authorized. rule: Sign refresh bindings with the current keyring version inside the unchanged zghrb_v1 envelope, verify with every listed version, accept unversioned bindings with any listed key, and refuse to boot Railway Alpha, Beta or Production without a dedicated key.
